title: Moritzburg Castle
visualBrief: Individual Moritzburg island palace: four pale cylindrical towers with red rounded domes, lanterns and finials; connected hipped palace ranges, projecting east entrance and separate dark west chapel spire; stone terrace, curved stair cut-outs, two axial retaining ramps, eight paired pavilions and two short mapped bridge gaps.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact-QID low palace plan plus 25 current PMTiles component polygons, full island park and two bridge centerlines.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped parts provide approximate29/34m range tops,35m dome parts and43m chapel finial. Eaves, profiles and window rhythm are photo-led estimates.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Mapped parts carry29/34m roof/range tops,35m broad dome parts,37m lantern/39m crown parts and43m chapel finial. Body eaves, window rhythm, profiles and terrace joins are inferred from exterior pictures; map heights are approximate rather than surveys.
reconstruction.scope: Palace, four domed towers, west chapel/spire, low terrace and curving stairs, two axial ramps, island retaining edge and eight paired pavilions. Only the two short mapped bridge gaps are modeled; long land causeways, lake and formal gardens beyond the island remain host map/terrain content. Island retaining boundary is a photo-led estimate; mappedParkOutline preserves the grass-area control.
reconstruction.islandBasis: Photo-led rectangular retaining perimeter estimated against all eight mapped paired pavilions and the two short bridge endpoints. The retained park landuse polygon describes grass areas, not the complete retaining edge; it is preserved separately as mappedParkOutline.

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Exterior and source-terrain fit inspected; corrected current geographic/shared views pending.

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 equals standard viewer DEM172.5507m at castle anchor. Flat islandY0.6m, terraceY5m, stairs and short bridges are approximate attachments; no survey or water-level guarantee.

geographicProposal.notes: Signed low main plan and current component/island polygons establish approximate fit; west chapel, east projecting range and south town bridge distinguish facing. NativeX follows N/S bridge axis to meet viewer suppression convention.0.8m low part is not palace height.
geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Source-terrain and isolated views inspected. NativeY0 follows retained standard viewer DEM at anchor; islandY0.6, terraceY5 and descending axial ramps are approximate attachments. Foundation skirts follow coarse DEM with0.15m overlap; no surveyed water-level or terrain-carving claim.

scaleBasis: Current mapped plans establish approximate palace84x71m, terrace102x99m and island210x254m; the retained0.8m low-part height is not applied to the palace.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license; map controls © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Linked photographs are not redistributed.
dataAttribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; Protomaps; Mapzen/USGS terrain tiles.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Mapped components establish approximate scale and facing; eaves, dome profiles, window/dormer rhythm and material colors are exterior-picture estimates.
The0.8m exact-QID part is a low plan only. Component heights are approximate mapped data, not certified building surveys.

The park polygon maps grass areas; the rectangular island retaining edge is a photo-led estimate against pavilion/bridge locations. Terrace stairs, island levels, short bridge engineering and coarse DEM/water joins are approximate; no terrain carving or surveyed lake level.
Long land causeways, lake, formal gardens beyond the island, site trees, detailed interiors and certified walkable collision are excluded.
Physical laptop and phone frame-rate measurements remain pending.
importReason: Preserve four recognizable dome towers, connected palace massing, chapel spire and island approaches in four independently authored browser levels.
